name: Massachusetts
title: Massachusetts Rebate Calculator 2026: Mass Save Heat Pump, Water Heater and More
h1: Massachusetts Rebate Calculator 2026: What Mass Save Pays for Your Home
desc: Free Massachusetts rebate calculator for Mass Save customers. See heat pump, water heater, insulation and solar incentives, with the official source for every amount.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Massachusetts rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Mass Save pays up to $8,500 for a whole-home air-source heat pump ($2,650 per ton), $750 for a heat pump water heater and 75% to 100% off insulation after a free home energy assessment. Households that qualify for the income-based Enhanced offer can get the heat pump at no cost or up to $16,000 back. Homes in a town with its own municipal electric company use different programs.
faq: How much is the Mass Save heat pump rebate in 2026?

Up to $8,500 for a whole-home air-source system, paid at $2,650 per ton. A partial-home system pays $1,125 per ton, up to $8,500. Households that qualify for Enhanced rebates can get the system at no cost or up to $16,000 back. Installs must be done in 2026 by a Heat Pump Installer Network contractor.
Do I qualify for Mass Save if my town has a municipal electric company?

Not for the electric programs. About 50 towns are served by municipal light plants. They use their own rebates and the 0% DOER MLP Z-Loan. If you heat with gas and the gas company is a Mass Save sponsor, some gas-side offers may still apply.
Is the federal tax credit for heat pumps still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended for spending after December 31, 2025.
Can I get a battery rebate in Massachusetts?
We found no upfront Mass Save battery rebate. Batteries earn money through the ConnectedSolutions program instead, about $1,375 a year for a 5 kW battery in MassCEC's example.

programs.name: Mass Save: whole-home air-source heat pump
programs.rules: Replaces oil, propane or electric baseboards, or gas from a Mass Save gas sponsor. ENERGY STAR cold-climate model, installed in 2026 by a Heat Pump Installer Network contractor. Needs enough weatherization. Apply by February 28, 2027.

programs.name: Mass Save: partial-home air-source heat pump
programs.rules: Same equipment and installer rules. Adds a $500 weatherization bonus and a $500 sizing bonus. Integrated controls required.

programs.name: Mass Save Enhanced: whole-home heat pump
programs.rules: Only for households that qualify for the income-based Enhanced offer. Not the standard amount.

programs.name: Mass Save: whole-home geothermal heat pump
programs.rules: Same eligibility rules as the air-source offer.

programs.name: Mass Save: partial-home geothermal heat pump
programs.rules: Same eligibility rules as the air-source offer.

programs.name: Mass Save Enhanced: geothermal heat pump
programs.rules: Only for households that qualify for the income-based Enhanced offer.

programs.name: Mass Save: heat pump water heater
programs.rules: An instant rebate when you replace an existing electric, oil, propane or gas water heater. The rebate never exceeds the cost.

programs.name: Mass Save: insulation and air sealing
programs.rules: Start with the free home energy assessment. 100% off is generally for income-qualified households, 75% is standard. Also $75 per window replaced with a triple-pane window.

programs.name: Massachusetts solar tax credit
programs.rules: 15% of the system cost, capped at $1,000, claimed on your state tax return.

programs.name: SMART solar program
programs.rules: MassCEC's example is about $300 a year for an 8 kW system. It is paid over time, so it is not added to your total. Only for National Grid, Eversource and Unitil customers.

programs.name: ConnectedSolutions battery program
programs.rules: MassCEC's example for a 5 kW battery. It is paid for letting the utility use the battery in peak events, so it is not added to your total.

programs.name: Mass Save: appliance rebates
programs.rules: $50 for an ENERGY STAR clothes dryer. $500 for an induction cooktop when you switch from gas or propane.

programs.name: Mass Save: free home energy assessment
programs.rules: A free virtual or in-person assessment. Income-qualified homes can get insulation, air sealing and heat pumps at no cost. Call 866-527-7283.

programs.name: Mass Save HEAT Loan
programs.rules: For heat pumps, insulation, heat pump water heaters and more. Terms up to 7 years.

programs.name: Energy Saver Home Loan
programs.rules: A low-interest loan for income-qualified households, up to 20 years.

programs.name: DOER MLP Z-Loan
programs.rules: For customers of a municipal light plant who are not eligible for Mass Save. Up to 5 years. Solar and EV chargers are excluded. Apply at myz-loan.com.

notes: Massachusetts also pays about $250 to $1,000 in Alternative Energy Certificates for a whole-home heat pump. It is a one-time payment and is not added to your total.
Mass Save's own site blocks automated readers, so per-ton amounts come from MassCEC and DOER pages that republish Mass Save offers. Confirm on masssave.com before you sign.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment and your final invoice.
